correctness.rationale: Use the twelve signed permutations of (1,1,0) and 24 distance-sqrt(2) edges. For x>y>z>0 the signed vertex-height event table gives exactly eight edge crossings for a central plane; crossing x−z changes the count by −2, crossing x+z by −2 and passing x+y by −4, while all other positive height events have zero increment. Direct independent edge-sweep on four strict generic directions reproduced 8,6,4 on the three offset windows; tie planes have measure zero. Under Euclidean-invariant hitting-plane measure, normals are width weighted, not uniformly sampled after conditioning. Integration over the 48 ordered-coordinate spherical chambers yields lengths ell8=x−z, ell6=2z, ell4=y−z and Stokes spherical vector-area terms I_j; Z=I1+I2=gamma/(2sqrt(2)), gamma=arctan sqrt(2). Thus p4=3−pi(2+sqrt(2))/(4 gamma)=0.1930593371243985; p6=pi sqrt(2)/(2gamma)−2=0.32534578267919967; p8=pi(2−sqrt(2))/(4gamma)=0.481594880196402, with expected sides 2pi/gamma=6.577071086144008. An invertible affine map preserves generic section polygon side counts but not the Euclidean kinematic probabilities. Null boundary and singular normal cases excluded.
